top_signals.title: WARNING: Don’t Expect This Freight Cycle to End Soon
top_signals.summary:
FreightWaves expert breaks down 20 years of freight market cycles, from the muted early 2000s to the current volatile environment. Discover how economic variables and policy changes have shaped boom and bust periods, leading to today’s complex supply chain challenges. Learn why assuming a quick end to the current cycle could be a critical mistake […]

top_signals.title: Owning Anthropic Before It Goes Public
top_signals.summary:
John Cole Scott, president and & CIO of CEF Advisors, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." Anthropic filed on Oct. 26 for an IPO that’s set to take place before Thanksgiving. Anthropic is seeking to meet or exceed the amount SpaceX raised in its $86.2 billion debut, people familiar with the matter have said.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Millennium Management is redeeming more than $1.5 billion of leveraged cash from two external hedge funds that the multistrategy investment firm backed last year.

top_signals.summary: Supermarket and grocery store refrigerators across Europe appear to have been hacked early Monday — the second such incident in recent weeks where attackers have manipulated temperature controls and caused stock to spoil.
